description: Store the sender details printed on every proposal, contract and letter, plus the currency, VAT, terms and prefix defaults. It writes the SAME shared profile as the invoice server's business_set.

brand_color.description: Letterhead colour as a hex code, e.g. 1F3864 (Pro)

default_currency.description: ISO code, e.g. EUR, USD. Default EUR

default_tax_rate.description: Default VAT percent, quoted on proposals

email.description: Your own email address, printed on every letterhead. Leave it out unless the user gave it: a document that shows an address nobody supplied is worse than one that shows [add: email]

iban.description: IBAN or account number for payment

invoice_prefix.description: Reference prefix used by mcp-invoice; this profile has the same field shape as mcp-invoice, so one profile serves both

logo_path.description: Path to a PNG or JPG logo for the letterhead (Pro)

name.description: Your business or freelancer name, printed on the letterhead of every proposal, contract and letter

payment_terms_days.description: Default days until payment is due. Default 14

phone.description: Your own phone number. Same rule as email: only if the user gave it

timezone.description: IANA zone you work in, e.g. Europe/Warsaw. Shared with time-tracker and timezone as your home zone

name: business_set
title: Set your business details
